entries.title: Job 38:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:

entries.title: Job 38:2
segments: "Who [is] this who darkens counsel By words without knowledge?

entries.title: Job 38:3
segments: Now prepare yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer Me.

entries.title: Job 38:4
segments: ¶"Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell [Me], if you have understanding.

entries.title: Job 38:5
segments: Who determined its measurements? Surely you know! Or who stretched the line upon it?

entries.title: Job 38:6
segments: To what were its foundations fastened? Or who laid its cornerstone,

entries.title: Job 38:7
segments: When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?

entries.title: Job 38:8
segments: "Or [who] shut in the sea with doors, When it burst forth [and] issued from the womb;

entries.title: Job 38:9
segments: When I made the clouds its garment, And thick darkness its swaddling band;

entries.title: Job 38:10
segments: When I fixed My limit for it, And set bars and doors;

entries.title: Job 38:11
segments: When I said, 'This far you may come, but no farther, And here your proud waves must stop!'

entries.title: Job 38:12
segments: ¶"Have you commanded the morning since your days [began, And] caused the dawn to know its place,

entries.title: Job 38:13
segments: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked be shaken out of it?

entries.title: Job 38:14
segments: It takes on form like clay [under] a seal, And stands out like a garment.

entries.title: Job 38:15
segments: From the wicked their light is withheld, And the upraised arm is broken.

entries.title: Job 38:16
segments: "Have you entered the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in search of the depths?

entries.title: Job 38:17
segments: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the doors of the shadow of death?

entries.title: Job 38:18
segments: Have you comprehended the breadth of the earth? Tell [Me], if you know all this.

entries.title: Job 38:19
segments: "Where [is] the way [to] the dwelling of light? And darkness, where [is] its place,

entries.title: Job 38:20
segments: That you may take it to its territory, That you may know the paths [to] its home?

entries.title: Job 38:21
segments: Do you know [it], because you were born then, Or [because] the number of your days [is] great?

entries.title: Job 38:22
segments: "Have you entered the treasury of snow, Or have you seen the treasury of hail,

entries.title: Job 38:23
segments: Which I have reserved for the time of trouble, For the day of battle and war?

entries.title: Job 38:24
segments: By what way is light diffused, [Or] the east wind scattered over the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:25
segments: ¶"Who has divided a channel for the overflowing [water], Or a path for the thunderbolt,

entries.title: Job 38:26
segments: To cause it to rain on a land [where there is] no one, A wilderness in which [there is] no man;

entries.title: Job 38:27
segments: To satisfy the desolate waste, And cause to spring forth the growth of tender grass?

entries.title: Job 38:28
segments: Has the rain a father? Or who has begotten the drops of dew?

entries.title: Job 38:29
segments: From whose womb comes the ice? And the frost of heaven, who gives it birth?

entries.title: Job 38:30
segments: The waters harden like stone, And the surface of the deep is frozen.

entries.title: Job 38:31
segments: "Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, Or loose the belt of Orion?

entries.title: Job 38:32
segments: Can you bring out Mazzaroth in its season? Or can you guide the Great Bear with its cubs?

entries.title: Job 38:33
segments: Do you know the ordinances of the heavens? Can you set their dominion over the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:34
segments: "Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, That an abundance of water may cover you?

entries.title: Job 38:35
segments: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go, And say to you, 'Here we [are]!'?

entries.title: Job 38:36
segments: Who has put wisdom in the mind? Or who has given understanding to the heart?

entries.title: Job 38:37
segments: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of heaven,

entries.title: Job 38:38
segments: When the dust hardens in clumps, And the clods cling together?

entries.title: Job 38:39
segments: "Can you hunt the prey for the lion, Or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

entries.title: Job 38:40
segments: When they crouch in [their] dens, [Or] lurk in their lairs to lie in wait?

entries.title: Job 38:41
segments: Who provides food for the raven, When its young ones cry to God, And wander about for lack of food?
